jobs.name: ig15_cover
jobs.person_note: The man must be exactly the man from the attached photo (same face, swept-back silver hair, short grey beard, white polo shirt, steel watch).
jobs.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER: photorealistic frame of exactly the man from the attached photo sitting in a cream leather seat of a private jet in the LOWER half of the frame, calm confident look into the lens, he holds a smartphone in one hand turned face down toward the viewer, soft daylight from the oval windows, walnut panels. The upper part of the frame is a slightly darkened soft-focus cabin area for the title. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text, centred, in the upper-middle part of the frame: white heavy sans-serif lines «НЕ ОТВЕЧАЙ» / «НА ЗВОНКИ», then a large warm amber-gold #E8B04A line «ПОСЛЕ 19:00», with a soft dark shadow. No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, nothing readable on the phone.
jobs.style_qa: обложка: мужчина из приложенного фото (узнаваем, не искажён) в кресле частного самолёта держит телефон экраном вниз, надпись «НЕ ОТВЕЧАЙ НА ЗВОНКИ ПОСЛЕ 19:00» без ошибок, другого текста и логотипов нет, руки и пальцы без искажений
jobs.meaning: обложка 9:16 Reels «Не отвечай на звонки после семи»
jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The title block sits centred, its middle around 35% from the top, fully inside the central 4:5 safe area so it is not cropped in the profile grid; the title never covers his face, his face sits around 60% from the top.
